RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning the panel’s gender composition provides no basis for a claim of sex discrimination or bias in the hiring outcome. While an all-male panel may reflect broader institutional diversity deficits or potentially breach internal HR panel-composition guidelines, raising it will appear misplaced and undermine your professional standing.

The selection likely came down to the panel weighting formal management credentials and broad leadership experience more heavily than your doctorate and section-level clinical background. Instead of challenging panel demographics, send a polite follow-up regarding your request for written feedback, framing it as constructive career development to understand which leadership competencies separated the candidates.
